text: summer fruits: Heb. the gatherings of summer
mischevious desire: Heb. the mischief of the soul
She that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her: Or, and thou wilt see her that is mine enemy and cover her with shame | she be trodden down: Heb. she shall be for a treading down
Notwithstanding: Or, after that it hath been
